# Overrides and adds customized gems in this file
# Read more on documentation:
# * English: https://github.com/consul/consul/blob/master/CUSTOMIZE_EN.md#gemfile
# * Spanish: https://github.com/consul/consul/blob/master/CUSTOMIZE_ES.md#gemfile

group :development do
  gem 'rack-mini-profiler'
  gem 'solargraph'
  # gem 'prosopite'
  # gem 'pg_query'

  gem 'foreman', '~> 0.90.0'
end

gem 'httparty'
gem 'sd_notify', '~> 0.1.1'

gem 'ruby-saml', '~> 1.16'

gem 'geocoder', '~> 1.8', '>= 1.8.3'
gem 'rgeo', '~> 3.0', '>= 3.0.1'
gem 'rgeo-geojson', '~> 2.2'

gem "sentry-ruby"
gem "sentry-rails"

gem "acts_as_list"
gem "jwt"
gem 'rack-cors'

gem "prawn", "2.5.0"
gem 'prawn-svg', '~> 0.37.0'
gem "rqrcode", "~> 2.0"

# Adm
gem 'jsbundling-rails', '~> 1.3', '>= 1.3.1'
gem 'cssbundling-rails', '~> 1.4', '>= 1.4.3'

gem 'turbo-rails'

gem 'pundit', '~> 2.5', '>= 2.5.1'
gem 'pagy', '~> 9.4'
# /Adm

gem 'liquid'

gem 'ruby_llm', '1.14.1'

gem 'pdf-reader', '2.15.1'

gem 'docx', '0.10.0'

group :development, :test do
  gem 'database_cleaner', '~> 2.0.1'
  gem 'pry', '~> 0.14'
  gem 'pry-byebug', '~> 3.9'
  gem 'pry-rails'

  # Improves pry shortcuts
  gem 'rb-readline', '0.5.5'

  gem 'rswag-spec

observation.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="Gemfile_custom"
s=open(p).read()
if "database_cleaner" not in s:
    s=s.replace("group :development, :test do\n", "group :development, :test do\n  gem 'database_cleaner', '~> 2.0.1'\n",1)
    open(p,"w").write(s)
print(open(p).read()[:1200])
PY
